# BoldCrest

> BoldCrest is a creative and branding agency based in Tirana, Albania, building bold brand identities, packaging, photography, video, and campaigns for ambitious brands. 300+ projects, 30+ brands, 7+ years. Tagline: "Go bold or go unseen."

BoldCrest is a full-service creative agency working with Albanian and international
clients across food & beverage, hospitality, retail, health & beauty, real estate,
and more. Core services: brand strategy and identity, packaging design, photography,
video and TVC (television commercial) production, animation, social media management,
and advertising.

- Name: BoldCrest
- Location: Tirana, Albania
- Contact: info@boldcrest.com
- Website: https://www.boldcrest.com
- Track record: 300+ projects, 30+ brands, 7+ years

- [Home](https://www.boldcrest.com/): who BoldCrest is, selected work, and services.
- [Work / Portfolio](https://www.boldcrest.com/work): 50+ case studies in branding, packaging, photography, video, and campaigns.
- [Services](https://www.boldcrest.com/services): branding, packaging design, photography, video/TVC, advertising, and social media.
- [Diary (Blog)](https://www.boldcrest.com/diary): articles on branding, design thinking, and creative strategy.
- [People](https://www.boldcrest.com/people): the BoldCrest team.
